data.name: Hood
data.long_meaning: Originally derived from Old English word ‘hoh’, meaning ‘enclosure’, ‘hideaway’, or ‘refuge’, the name Hood has since evolved to denote various meanings. It can refer to a cloak with a hood, a place of shelter, or even a person with a hooded appearance. In contemporary times, the name Hood is also associated with the hoodlum culture, particularly in gangs and criminal organizations.

Further, in Islamic history, certain sacred places or fugitives were referred to as huud or hawaadith, sites of refuge or sanctuary.
